first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing directly threatens the segment where targeted promotional pricing previously generated strong acquisition and revenue lift. Run a bounded, segment-targeted pricing experiment rather than a broad discount rollout; verify prior pricing durability and the competing onboarding evidence before final commitment. Guard against margin, customer-quality, and post-promotion retention risk.

final.rationale: Prioritize a shortened/simplified onboarding experiment. The verified source showed completion up 13%, time-to-value faster by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention up 3%, directly addressing the current onboarding and activation declines with evidence of downstream durability. Avoid promotional pricing: its verified qualified-revenue lift came with 30-day retention down 12%, making it unsuitable for the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Monitor whether simplification changes lead quality and longer-horizon qualified revenue, which were not directly measured in the verified onboarding record.
